tasks.short: Judge whether advertising and promotion programs fit the fundraising efforts

steps.what: Name the fundraising appeals and the donor ask
Pull advertising and promotion results beside those appeals
Check the advertising offer matches the named promotion
Decide which promotion programs fit the fundraising efforts

tasks.design: She names the fundraising appeals and the donor ask on the {CRM}. {BI} pulls advertising and promotion results from {ADS} beside those appeals. She checks that each result is the named promotion and decides which programs fit the fundraising efforts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Appeal dates and campaign results lived in different places, and compatibility is a judgement about donors, not a formula.
tasks.enabler_now: A connector can place channel results next to the appeals she already names. The compatibility call stays hers.
tasks.still_hard: A local promotion with no campaign record, and knowing which clash would actually tire a donor.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell a promotion that tires the same donors as an appeal from one that merely shares a week.

ambition.what: Compare a promotion program with the fundraising appeals the week it is booked

tasks.altitude: She still makes every compatibility call. She spends less time copying campaign results into the comparison.

reach.task: Read the promotion program beside the appeal
reach.learn: Which campaign dates the marketing manager already fixed, so she does not judge a program that has already ended.

evidence.claim: Funnel standardises channel data through connectors and produces automated reports for analysing how channels perform.
Matching a campaign name to an appeal name is a filter on records already held. It does not judge whether the same donors would be tired.

assumptions: She produces the appeal name, the ask, the audience and the dates in the first step. The advertising platform already holds channel, dates and response; that runtime is not her hours. There is no code map to keep. If a campaign name does not match the appeal, she gathers that program by hand.
The comparison is not a score of a colleague. Recording the decision is her internal note, not a send outside the organisation.
unknowns: Whether a marketing manager, not her, owns the advertising calendar.
Whether response figures sit in the advertising platform or only in a mailbox.
research_questions: How often a promotion program has no campaign record to join to an appeal?

already_counted.description: Naming the appeals, checking the offer, and the compatibility decision stay her time.

incremental.description: Programs with no matching campaign name, which she still gathers by hand.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Campaigns already in the advertising platform save the copy into the comparison. A one-off local promotion has no feed, and she still makes every compatibility call.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design and edit promotional publications such as brochures

steps.what: Write appeal, audience and date for promotional publications
Draft promotional publications such as brochures from the facts

loop.input: The appeal, audience and date she wrote for the publication.
loop.output: Brochure sentences for a promotional publication.
loop.check: Every amount, date and audience in the sentences is in the brochure facts, not only the publication title.
loop.stop: A sentence adds a result, a promise or a date that is not in the facts, or the draft is unsure.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed heading list cannot write the appeal sentence, and it cannot tell a new promise from a fact she recorded.

steps.what: Check the promotional publication against the appeal facts
Send the accepted promotional publications to the public site

tasks.design: She writes the appeal, the audience and the date on the {CRM}. A draft of the promotional publication is prepared in {DOCS} from those facts only. She checks every claim, and only then does the {CMS} publish that accepted publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each brochure was written from scratch, and a wrong public claim is costly to take back.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can write from facts she supplies, and the public file can wait until she accepts that text.
tasks.still_hard: A new appeal with no prior wording, and a promise that is implied rather than written in the facts.
tasks.human_edge: She can see a sentence that promises a result the facts never stated.

ambition.what: Stop a brochure the day a sentence adds a date or a result she did not write

tasks.altitude: She still accepts every publication. She spends less time on the first draft.

reach.learn: Which phrases the public relations manager already approved, so the brochure does not invent a claim.

evidence.claim: HubSpot agents draft campaign plans, branded content and nurture emails. The vendor average of a 26% higher deal win rate has no method, so it is not a time saving here.
From 2 August 2026, chatbots must say they are AI, synthetic content must be marked, and deepfakes must be disclosed.
A log of who released a publication records who did what, so Dutch works-council consent applies under WOR art. 27(1)(l).

assumptions: She supplies the appeal name, the audience, the date and any amount the publication may state. The draft may not add a figure. Section headings she reuses are her upkeep, counted in the incremental hours, not machine runtime.

The public file goes out only after she accepts that exact text. A later edit voids the release. The draft is marked as machine-written until she accepts it. This step does not send a marketing email.
unknowns: Whether a communications lead must accept the publication as well as her.
Whether the publication is print, web, or both.
research_questions: How often the draft adds a claim she then deletes?

already_counted.description: Writing the appeal facts and checking every claim stay her time.

incremental.description: She keeps the section headings herself, and she rewrites drafts the read stopped on. That upkeep is her work, not machine runtime.

approvals.approved_version: accepted promotional publication the fundraising manager released

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A repeat appeal with facts already written saves the first draft. A new story still needs her sentences, and she still checks every publication. The vendor win-rate figure has no method, so it is not this range.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct external agencies on fundraising programs

steps.what: Write the audience, offer and deadline for the agencies
Draft the fundraising brief for those external agencies
Check the brief keeps her fundraising offer and deadline
Send the accepted fundraising brief to the agencies
Direct the agencies on the fundraising programs in the meeting

tasks.design: She writes the audience, the offer and the deadline on the {CRM}. A brief is filled from those points, she checks it, and {EMAIL} sends it to the agency only after she accepts it. She still directs the agencies in the meeting.
tasks.previous_blocker: The brief and the meeting are how she directs people outside, and the direction changes with the agency.
tasks.enabler_now: A brief can be filled from the audience, offer and deadline she writes, and the email can wait for her acceptance.
tasks.still_hard: The meeting itself, and an agency that needs a different shape of brief.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell when an agency has understood the offer and when the meeting needs a harder direction.

ambition.what: Send the agency brief the day the offer or the deadline changes

tasks.altitude: She still directs every agency meeting. She spends less time retyping the brief email.

reach.task: Brief the agency on the campaign channel
reach.learn: Which channel the marketing manager already assigned, so she does not direct the agency onto a closed channel.

evidence.claim: Filling an audience, an offer and a deadline into a brief she already outlined is ordinary mail configuration. Keeping the brief headings is her work.
A log of who sent the agency brief records who did what, so Dutch works-council consent applies under WOR art. 27(1)(l).

assumptions: She produces the audience, the offer and the deadline. She keeps the brief headings herself; that upkeep is in the incremental hours, not machine runtime. The meeting is not shortened.
The email is the brief she accepted. The agency's own production time is outside this task and is not counted as her hours. The meeting is a conversation, not a second send of the brief.
unknowns: Whether procurement, not her, contracts the agency.
Whether the agency reads a portal rather than email.
research_questions: How many agency briefs repeat the same offer and deadline?

already_counted.description: Writing the direction, checking the brief, and the agency meeting stay her time.

incremental.description: She keeps the brief headings herself, and she rewrites a brief when the offer will not fit the headings. That is her work, not machine runtime.

approvals.approved_version: accepted agency brief the fundraising manager released

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A known agency and a repeated offer save the brief email. A new program still needs the meeting, and she still directs every agency.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Produce films, regulate distribution, and keep the film library

steps.what: Shoot and store the films for this appeal
Read each film label into the video library

loop.input: The label on the film master.
loop.output: Title, date and length for the library.
loop.check: The title words mean the appeal subject, not only a file number.
loop.stop: The title or the date is missing, or the read is unsure.
loop.why_not_simpler: A file number is not the film's subject, and the label is free text.

steps.what: Decide which films may go out and who may be shown
Send only the films she cleared for distribution

tasks.design: She shoots the films and stores the master in {DOCS}. The library title and date are read from the label, and she decides who may be shown and whether the film may go out. {EMAIL} sends only that cleared film, and only to people she has already allowed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The shoot, the consent of people shown, and the decision to release are not a form.
tasks.enabler_now: A label can be read into library fields, and the email can wait until she clears that film.
tasks.still_hard: The shoot, image consent, and a showing that is not an email.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which person in the film has not agreed to be shown, even when the label looks complete.

ambition.what: Hold a film the day the people shown are not cleared

tasks.altitude: She still shoots and still clears every film. She spends less time retyping library labels and rebuilding a release email.

reach.task: Clear a public film before it is shown
reach.learn: Which stories the public relations manager will not put in public, so a library film is not released against that.

evidence.claim: Reading a title and a date from a film label into library fields is a bounded extract. It does not decide whether a person may be shown.
Marketing email needs prior consent, except to a firm's own customers about similar products, and each message needs an opt-out.
The Dutch email code requires active consent and an opt-out within 7 days.
An objection to direct marketing, profiling included, stops it.
From 2 August 2026, chatbots must say they are AI, synthetic content must be marked, and deepfakes must be disclosed.
A log of who released a film records who did what, so Dutch works-council consent applies under WOR art. 27(1)(l).
After an update on 18 January 2024, DPD's service chatbot swore at a customer and called DPD the worst delivery firm, and DPD disabled the AI element.

assumptions: The label yields title, date and length. She adds whether each person shown may be public, and she names the recipients. The extract does not invent consent. Keeping library headings is not a separate machine job.

Email goes only to addresses on the list she cleared. An address with an objection is left out. She decides whether donors fall under the similar-products exception. The design does not generate the picture, and it does not use an unattended public reply. A live showing is not this email.
unknowns: Whether image consent is already on file for the people shown.
Whether a distributor outside the organisation operates the library.
Whether donors count as the firm's own customers for the similar-products email exception.
research_questions: How many films are released by email rather than at an event?

already_counted.description: The shoot and the clearance of who may be shown stay her time.

incremental.description: Labels the read stops on, which she types herself, and a release the channel refuses, which she rebuilds.

approvals.approved_version: cleared film the fundraising manager released

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A labelled master saves the library typing. The shoot still takes the time, and she still clears every film. A live showing has no email to save.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still decides which advertising and promotion programs fit the fundraising efforts, still accepts every promotional publication, still directs every agency, and still clears every film. She spends less time copying results, first drafts, brief emails and library labels.
skills_to_grow: Name the appeal, the audience and the dates before a promotion is compared.
Reject a publication sentence that states a result or a date she did not write.
State the agency's audience, offer and deadline before a brief is sent.
Refuse a film when the people shown have not agreed to be public.
role.ambitious_version: Not a tool that calls a promotion compatible, publishes a brochure she has not accepted, directs an agency she has not briefed, or releases a film she has not cleared. Not an unattended public reply.
